This overview highlights selected areas of academic activity at the **Universidad de Valladolid**. It is a public profile, **not a substitute for the official certified CV and supporting documents** used in academic evaluation procedures.

## Academic appointment

**Profesor Titular de Universidad**, Departamento de Física Teórica, Atómica y Óptica, Universidad de Valladolid. Member of the Instituto de Matemáticas de la Universidad de Valladolid (IMUVA).

## Research and teaching record

- **Three research evaluation periods (sexenios)** and **three teaching evaluation periods (quinquenios)**.
- **Two doctoral theses defended**, together with ongoing doctoral supervision.
- **Twelve Bachelor's theses (TFG)**, including six associated with *Becas de Colaboración*, and **four Master's theses (TFM)** supervised.

See [Teaching & supervision](teaching.qmd) for details and [Publications](publications.qmd) for published research outputs.

## Academic responsibilities

Selected coordination and institutional responsibilities include:

- Erasmus mobility coordination for Italy and SICUE coordination.
- Mobility coordination within the Physics section.
- Elected membership of the Physics section board (*Junta de Sección de Física*).
- Membership of the Physics degree committee (*Comité de Grado de Física*).



## Scientific organisation and leadership

- Main organiser of the **36th International Colloquium on Group Theoretical Methods in Physics (GROUPS36)**, Valladolid, July 2026.
- Additional international scientific meetings listed in [Research](research.qmd).
